purpose: The F2a operation-by-adapter capability matrix. For each operation on the filesystem roster it records what the PINNED side does -- supported, a deliberate capability error with its text, or absent -- what the Rust port has, which prepared cases reach it, and which hosts its answer is valid on. Absence in the Rust trait is recorded as an implementation gap, never as a reason to omit the operation.
